mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q01.stem: An instrument has 10 equal intervals between 10 and 30. What is one division?
reasons: This is the whole range difference.
This uses the interval count as the value.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q02.stem: An EU-bound part receives RoHS and REACH inquiries. What information should be organized first?
options: Item, constituent information, applicability and supply role
reasons: This supports comparison with current requirements.
It does not replace checks of product-substance rules.
This cannot identify constituents or applicability.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q03.stem: Electrocoating connections are being chosen from ordinary plating memory alone. What is appropriate?
options: Check method, specified electrode side and equipment conditions
Every electrical method uses identical polarity
Have an untrained person choose by trial
reasons: Color is unrelated to electrode conditions.
Authority and safety procedures are necessary.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q04.stem: The record field requires A; the display is 75 mA. What is correct?
reasons: It differs by one decimal place.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q05.stem: A manufacturing-friendly specification differs from customer requirements. What quality action is needed?
options: Let the workplace alone change drawings
Confirm requirements and change approval, linking design and manufacturing
Ease of manufacture always means equivalence
reasons: Manufacturing convenience alone does not determine quality.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q06.stem: For complete neutralization, what equivalent concentration corresponds to 0.20 mol/L sulfuric acid?
reasons: 1 mol sulfuric acid is 2 equivalents in this reaction.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q07.stem: A customer needs a conductive resin part. What is appropriate about a metal coating?
options: Immerse unconditionally in the same bath as metal
Check approved-method compatibility including material and pretreatment
Resin can never receive metal films

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q08.stem: An exercise uses 6.0 g solute,60 g/mol molar mass and 0.25 L final solution. What is molarity?
reasons: This confuses mass concentration with molarity.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q09.stem: An analysis measured acidity. Using it to guarantee every metal concentration is proposed. What is appropriate?
options: Compare the target constituent and necessary separate analysis
reasons: The result's target does not change.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-practical-q10.stem: Classify an iron-based material and a copper alloy. What is appropriate?
options: Check ferrous/nonferrous categories against material information
reasons: Corrosion resistance depends on material and environment.
